scenarios.name: Import and replay a normal six-max hand
scenarios.given: A valid structured hand history with blinds, preflop raise/call, flop/turn/river actions and showdown
scenarios.then: The system stores one normalized hand and deterministic decision snapshots whose stacks/pot/actions match the fixture.

scenarios.name: Reject impossible duplicate cards
scenarios.given: A source hand contains the same physical card in hero hole cards and board
scenarios.then: The hand is rejected or quarantined with a card-uniqueness invariant error and is excluded from analytics.

scenarios.name: Compute fold-to-3bet correctly
scenarios.given: A player opens, faces a legal 3bet, and has a real fold/call/raise decision
scenarios.then: That decision contributes exactly one opportunity and contributes success only if the player folds.

scenarios.name: Avoid fake confidence from five observations
scenarios.given: A player has 4 folds in 5 relevant opportunities and a configured population prior
scenarios.then: It shows raw 80%, sample 5, posterior estimate/interval, and low-confidence status rather than treating 80% as a stable truth.

scenarios.name: Exact equity on tractable river
scenarios.given: Hero hand, opponent weighted range, and complete board leave no future cards
scenarios.then: The engine enumerates every legal opponent combo, handles ties, and returns exact weighted equity.

scenarios.name: Recommendation is sensitive to uncertain fold rate
scenarios.given: Two actions have close EV and opponent fold frequency has a wide credible interval
scenarios.then: It reports that action ordering is fragile and shows the key threshold rather than a high-confidence single answer.

scenarios.name: Live data becomes stale
scenarios.given: A table adapter stops updating during an active hand
scenarios.when: The HUD receives no newer validated snapshot within its freshness budget
scenarios.then: The decision panel marks data stale and suppresses fresh-looking recommendations based on old state.

scenarios.name: Post-session leak training
scenarios.given: Many graded hands show repeated EV loss in BB-vs-BTN turn decisions
scenarios.when: Leak detection and trainer generation run
scenarios.then: The report groups the spot definition, shows supporting hands/confidence/cumulative modeled loss, and creates a drill queue targeting that concept.

scenarios.name: Solver fails to converge within budget
scenarios.given: A re-solving job reaches latency/iteration budget without sufficient convergence evidence
scenarios.then: The engine returns approximate/uncertain status with diagnostics and does not label the strategy exact GTO.
